ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Ref. No.: WAN/LND/05/AQUIS/01-L4. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4/3/16/2019/UDA/179. I hereby notify that the Government intends to acquire the following land for the fourth phase of Urban Development Activities including Solid Waste Management Project under Sub section (1), Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460) as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964. The particulars of the land intend to acquire: Allotments of the land within the boundaries mentioned below, depicted in sheet No. 01 of Zone No. 01 in Cadastral Map No. 410058 prepared by District Superintendent of Surveys on 30th of December 2024 and situated in Serakkuliya Village in Serakkuliya Grama Niladhari Division No. 635/3 in Wanathawilluwa Divisional Secretary's Division of Puttalam District, North Western Province.

Lot No. 2 - Extent: 8.1432 Hectares. North: Lot No. 2 in PPPu 658; East: Lot No. 1 in PPPu 5500; South: Lot Nos. 6 and 3; West: Lot Nos. 3 and 1. Lot No. 3 - Extent: 11.2855 Hectares. North: Lot Nos. 1 and 2; East: Lot Nos. 2 and 6; South: Lot Nos. 2, 6, 4, 5 and Lot No. 1 in PPPu 658; West: Lot No. 1 and 5. Lot No. 5 - Extent: 0.7245 Hectare. North: Lot No. 3; East: Lot No. 3; South: Lot No. 3; West: Lot No. 1. Lot No. 6 - Extent: 1.0313 Hectares. North: Lot Nos. 3 and 2; East: Lot No. 554 in FTP 25; South: Lot No. 1 in PPPu 658 and Lot No. 3 of this Plan; West: Lot Nos. 3 and 4. Those who claim rights, ownership or any other connection on the above said land or authorized persons on their documents should meet me on 14.07.2025 at 9.30 a.m. at the Divisional Secretariat, Wanathawilluwa.
